# 01 — Product vision

Version0.1 · 22/11/2026 · **PROPOSED, READY-FOR-REVIEW status pending audit**. Only the direction and documentation-only boundary have Founder approval. This file is not implementation authorization.

## Direction and product promise

**APPROVED — DEC-001:** “Fokus Time — giúp sinh viên biến một buổi tập trung thành tiến bộ học tập có thể tự kiểm tra.” Source: Founder message SELECTED PRODUCT DEFINITION & DEV STUDIO HANDOFF, [global DEC-0001](../../portfolio/decision-log.md).

**PROPOSED — DEC-002:** primary user is a university student independently studying a defined exercise/topic with existing legitimate learning material and a way to compare their answer. The user is not required to study on the phone; they can do the actual work on paper or in another tool. Vietnam/Vietnamese is the initial language proposal, not evidence that Vietnam demand has been validated. iOS and Android remain the intended platforms.

**PROPOSED promise:** make one learning goal explicit, let the student do the work, then help them record what they could do, what they could not yet do and a concrete next step after comparison. The app distinguishes a saved session from knowledge verified by an independent assessor. No claim of improved grades, objectively measured attention, mastery, medical benefit or market uniqueness.

## One complete value loop

Prepare one goal and comparison reference → study with the phone put away if useful → make a self-test attempt → compare with the existing reference/rubric → save a self-reported conclusion and the gap/next action → find that conclusion on return.

The original commitment is retained once learning starts. Changing it cannot silently turn the old commitment into a success. A student who cannot assess the result can save an explicitly unassessed conclusion. Leaving or interrupting the app never proves learning happened.

## Outcome and measurement boundaries

| Layer | What the product can establish | What remains a hypothesis |
|---|---|---|
| Functional correctness | A commitment/result saved, allowed transitions, consistent recovery, honest labels and deletion | Dev Studio must implement/test; none exercised here |
| User-perceived value | Learner reports a useful gap/next step and voluntarily uses the loop again | No observed cohort evidence in this definition session |
| Learning efficacy | A separate appropriately designed comparison could assess delayed learning or effort with a quality floor | App self-checks, session counts and elapsed time do not establish this |
| Business | Payment/distribution/retention could be evaluated separately | No price, paid plan, conversion or target-market advantage approved |

Efficiency with non-inferior learning and improved learning with comparable effort are different research promises. They must be chosen and measured before seeing results; a tiny test finding no significant difference does not establish non-inferiority. The software baseline does not need to implement a learning-assessment research engine.

## Product boundaries

The proposed MVP is a single-person, offline, self-entered learning-session tool. It uses the learner's own exercises and comparison sources; it does not fetch, license, create or grade learning content. No account/cloud sync, AI tutor, automatic grading, flashcard scheduler, social room, parent/teacher monitoring, camera evidence album, blocker or penalty/streak system. **Timer/countdown/alarms are PROPOSED OUT OF SCOPE for this MVP.** A learner may independently use another timer; no integration is implied.

The operational promise is a clear **self-reported conclusion about a particular attempt**, not measured progress. A learner normally expects access to a comparison source, but temporary absence/inadequacy has a legitimate unassessed path, not a product source-finding obligation. An assisted attempt can retain useful gaps while the summary explicitly says “Chưa xác nhận tự làm — đã đối chiếu có trợ giúp” when comparison was actually declared.

Prior Market/Red Team concerns remain: worksheet, Anki, RemNote or an existing study workflow may already be sufficient. That uncertainty informs claims and the MVP boundary; it does not reopen the Founder's selection. The Founder did not formally reject all other directions or approve all previous council recommendations.

## Context provenance

[Prior proposal](../../sessions/2026-11-21-01-fokus-time/08-top-proposals.md), [customer evidence](../../sessions/2026-11-21-01-fokus-time/02-customer-jtbd.md), [Red Team final](../../sessions/2026-11-21-01-fokus-time/records/redteam-r2-final.md), [definition intake](reviews/00-definition-intake.md). Prior evidence is dated21/11/2026; no market scan repeated. APPROVED/PROPOSED/OPEN/REJECTED and evidence confidence are separate axes; see [decision register](09-decisions-and-open-questions.md).

# 02 — Requirements and traceability index

Version0.1 · 22/11/2026 · **PROPOSED**. The Founder approved direction DEC-001 and documentation-only scope; no FR/BR/UX/NFR/AC below is Founder-approved. MUST means essential in this proposed MVP, not permission to implement.

| Requirement | Purpose / primary user | Priority | Rules / journeys / interface | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-001 — Prepare a commitment | Student states what they will attempt and how they may compare it; save incomplete draft | MUST | BR-001/002/009; UX-J01/J02; UX-S01/S02 | AC-001–004 |
| FR-002 — Start one session | Freeze the original commitment and enter learning explicitly, once | MUST | BR-001/003/008; UX-J01; UX-S02/S03 | AC-005–007 |
| FR-003 — Manage an open learning workflow | Leave/return, enter check, return to learning, change goal or close without assessment | MUST | BR-003/004/005/008; UX-J03/J04; UX-S03/S04 | AC-008–012 |
| FR-004 — Record a self-check draft | Distinguish self-attempt, assistance and actual comparison without collecting the exercise itself | MUST | BR-005/006/009; UX-J01/J02; UX-S04 | AC-013–016 |
| FR-005 — Save a truthful conclusion | Close with a qualified self-assessment or explicit unassessed result | MUST | BR-005/006/008; UX-J01/J02; UX-S04/S05 | AC-017–021 |
| FR-006 — Save and recover | Whole saved state survives interruption; no false success, duplicates or silent reset | MUST | BR-008/010; UX-J05; UX-S01–S05 | AC-022–026 |
| FR-007 — Read history and withdraw a mistaken conclusion | Find original commitment/result; correct the claim by withdrawal annotation without rewriting the past | MUST | BR-007/010/011; UX-J06; UX-S01/S05 | AC-027–030 |
| FR-008 — Use a past gap as a new draft | Reduce re-entry when learner chooses to revisit a gap | SHOULD; outside committed MUST baseline | BR-001/003/007; UX-J07; UX-S01/S02/S05 | AC-031–032 if included |
| FR-009 — Delete one record or all local learning data | Control retention and handle deletion failure honestly | MUST | BR-008/010/011; UX-J08; UX-S01/S05/dialogs | AC-033–036 |

Functional domain grouping: preparation FR001/002; learning and self-check FR003–005; continuity FR006; reflection and personal data FR007–009. No account, course taxonomy, dashboard, timer dependency or content platform is implied.

All FRs have details in [functional specification](03-functional-specification.md), product rules in [data behavior](05-business-rules-and-data.md), journeys/screen behavior in [UX](04-user-journeys.md), platform/quality expectations in [NFR](06-non-functional-requirements.md) and Given/When/Then scenarios in [AC](07-acceptance-criteria.md). Ranges are lookup references, not unique identifiers. Individual AC entries identify their related FR/BR/NFR/UX.

Acceptance of software behavior does not validate learning efficacy. User value remains HYPOTHESIS, independently from whether a requirement is testable or later approved. Monetization, target-market advantage, learning superiority/non-inferiority and demand are not silently included requirements. No existing research review is a test execution receipt.

# 03 — Functional specification

Version0.1 · 22/11/2026 · **PROPOSED**. Primary user throughout: the individual student. Common precondition: current local dataset readable, no account/network/sensitive permission required. [BR](05-business-rules-and-data.md) is authoritative for shared guards, limits and states; [AC](07-acceptance-criteria.md) specifies observable tests. An implementation remains unauthorized.

## FR-001 — Prepare and save a commitment

- **Purpose/priority/status:** state an actionable self-test goal with little input; MUST/PROPOSED.
- **Precondition/trigger:** no open record, or editing current DRAFT; learner chooses new/continue draft. With an open LEARNING/CHECKING record, show that record instead (BR001).
- **Inputs/outputs:** goal; optional material locator; comparison plan READY/NOT_READY and planned reference when ready. Output is one editable DRAFT and truthful saved/unsaved feedback.
- **Primary workflow:** enter draft → explicitly Save draft or Start (FR002). No compulsory personal profile, subject taxonomy, answer, photo, duration or schedule.
- **Alternative:** save incomplete draft for later; delete draft with FR009; NOT_READY can later Start with visible assessment limitation.
- **Rules/states/validation:** BR001/002/008; save DRAFT→DRAFT, incomplete allowed, type/length limits still apply. Choosing READY with missing source is an incomplete draft, not start-ready. No semantic quality certification.
- **Errors/recovery/cancel:** inline field error preserves input. Failed save does not navigate or say saved; retry same draft, no duplicate. Unsaved navigation uses save/discard/keep-editing dialog; external kill can lose unacknowledged edits only (FR006).
- **Dependencies/acceptance:** FR006/009; UX-S01/S02; AC001–004.

## FR-002 — Start the committed session once

- **Purpose/priority/status:** establish what this attempt is about before doing the work; MUST/PROPOSED.
- **Precondition/trigger:** current DRAFT; learner taps Start. An existing open record cannot be bypassed through history/new-draft entry points.
- **Inputs/outputs:** draft fields; output immutable original commitment, start event, same record LEARNING.
- **Primary workflow:** validate BR002 → save commitment+phase as a whole → acknowledge and show goal with “khi sẵn sàng, tự thử rồi đối chiếu”.
- **Alternative:** NOT_READY allowed, show comparison not ready; learner can save draft/leave instead. Start is never a hidden side-effect of opening setup.
- **Rules/states/validation:** DRAFT→LEARNING; BR001/002/003/008. No timer/minimum study duration; Start not evidence of attention or ability.
- **Errors/recovery/cancel:** invalid start keeps DRAFT and values; failure/interrupt produces full pre/post state only; repeated tap/retry/return cannot start another record. Cancellation before action leaves draft.
- **Dependencies/acceptance:** FR001/006; UX-S02/S03; AC005–007.

## FR-003 — Continue, check, stop or change goal

- **Purpose/priority/status:** control a real learning bout without a rigid timer; MUST/PROPOSED.
- **Precondition/trigger:** LEARNING or CHECKING; user chooses check, leave, return to learning, end without conclusion or change goal.
- **Inputs/outputs:** action and confirmation where destructive; optional new goal later in created DRAFT. Outputs follow BR004, never an inferred successful session.
- **Primary workflow:** LEARNING→CHECKING explicitly. Save and leave keeps current phase. Screen Back only navigates; return opens that same record/phase.
- **Alternatives:** direct end without assessment→CLOSED/UNASSESSED; change goal confirms closing original UNASSESSED and creating one prefilled DRAFT; CHECKING→LEARNING confirms deleting saved+unsaved check draft. No PAUSED/CANCELED state, no automatic resume/close.
- **Rules/states/validation:** BR001/003–006/008. Original goal cannot be overwritten after Start. Goal-change clears attempt/actual comparison/verdict/gap from the new draft. Close unassessed never requires an excuse; no old “pass” transfers.
- **Errors/recovery/cancel:** cancel confirms no change, including in-memory check text; write failure no partial split/clearing. Restart shows old intact state or complete intended state. Repeated goal-change creates at most one successor draft.
- **Dependencies/acceptance:** FR004/005/006; UX-S03/S04; AC008–012.

## FR-004 — Save a partial self-check

- **Purpose/priority/status:** distinguish independent attempt, assisted work and uncertainty from actual comparison; MUST/PROPOSED.
- **Precondition/trigger:** CHECKING; learner records current self-test situation or chooses Save for later.
- **Inputs/outputs:** attempt mode, comparison status (not confirmed / done but insufficient / done and sufficient), actual source reference, optional note and draft outcome/gap. Output remains a **draft self-check**, not an assessment.
- **Primary workflow:** display original goal/plan → learner self-attempts outside app → declares help used during that attempt → compares outside app and states whether it provides sufficient basis → names source if able → chooses proposed conclusion in FR005. Looking at the answer afterward only for comparison does not itself make the attempt assisted.
- **Alternatives:** source was not ready or inadequate; helped attempt; not sure; no attempted work. Save any incomplete draft respecting basic type/length, or close unassessed. Do not demand full answer, photo, source import or reteaching.
- **Rules/states/validation:** BR005/006/009. No attempt mode/verdict preselected. Assessed options only if eligible; changing a gate to ineligible clears assessed selection visibly, retains notes. Partial saves never run final-close validation or claim learning.
- **Errors/recovery/cancel:** field limits preserve input; save failure retry in place. Process interruption restores last acknowledged partial draft; unsaved edits not guaranteed. Explicit return to learning warns before clearing the entire check draft.
- **Dependencies/acceptance:** FR003/005/006; UX-S04; AC013–016.

## FR-005 — Conclude a session honestly

- **Purpose/priority/status:** pair the original commitment with a useful, explicitly self-reported conclusion; MUST/PROPOSED.
- **Precondition/trigger:** CHECKING with final user choice, or direct unassessed close from LEARNING. User taps Save conclusion or End without assessment.
- **Inputs/outputs:** eligible MEETS/PARTIAL/NOT_YET, or UNASSESSED; relevant attempt/comparison/source/gap/unknown-gap/note. Output CLOSED with complete result and freed slot.
- **Primary workflow:** validate exact BR005/006 conditions → save result+close event together → show original goal, attempt mode, comparison used, self-reported result and gap if supplied.
- **Alternative:** independent but uncertain, assisted, missing source or not attempted closes UNASSESSED; do not mark failed. PARTIAL/NOT_YET may explicitly say gap not identified. No forced next session.
- **Rules/states/validation:** eligible means independent self-attempt + comparison DONE_SUFFICIENT + nonempty actual reference. DONE_INSUFFICIENT is never eligible despite source text. PARTIAL/NOT_YET requires gap text or unknown-gap choice. UNASSESSED needs neither a fabricated diagnosis nor compulsory reason. Assisted comparison is labeled accurately, not simply “chưa tự kiểm”.
- **Errors/recovery/cancel:** invalid close stays CHECKING with inputs; duplicate close no duplicate record. Write/crash outcome all-or-none; no CLOSED without its result. Cancel close leaves saved phase and in-memory draft unchanged.
- **Dependencies/acceptance:** FR004/006/007; UX-S04/S05; AC017–021.

## FR-006 — Durable saves and recovery

- **Purpose/priority/status:** avoid silent loss, half-states and success feedback that did not happen; MUST/PROPOSED.
- **Precondition/trigger:** any draft save, transition, conclusion, withdrawal, deletion, retry or app return.
- **Inputs/outputs:** current action/content; output acknowledged durable result or explicit unsaved/error status; resume from actual saved state.
- **Primary workflow:** acknowledge only a whole saved action. Reopening restores the latest acknowledged phase and data in the current dataset. No state transition from app background/lock/kill/reboot, elapsed time or offline status.
- **Alternatives:** crash before acknowledgment may yield full old or full new state; reconcile without replay duplicates. OS restore can yield an older coherent snapshot (BR010), not latest-sync claims.
- **Rules/states/validation:** BR008/010 across all FRs, including two-record goal change and delete-all. Saves of incomplete drafts are allowed; no forced final validation. Stale action cannot overwrite current closed/deleted/newer record.
- **Errors/recovery/cancel:** write failure keeps in-memory edits while process lives, retry/discard available; no app-controlled navigation that loses them. OS force-kill cannot be prevented; only edits since last acknowledgment may be lost on ordinary restart. Read/corruption error never silently creates empty dataset; retry or explicit warned reset. No invented salvage/restore guarantee.
- **Dependencies/acceptance:** all data-mutating FRs; NFR001–004/006; AC022–026 plus each FR's failure scenarios. Choice of storage/atomicity implementation belongs to Dev Studio.

## FR-007 — History, detail and a withdrawn conclusion

- **Purpose/priority/status:** revisit the actual conclusion and recover from entering a mistaken verdict without rewriting learning history; MUST/PROPOSED.
- **Precondition/trigger:** dataset readable, user opens home/history/detail; withdrawal requires CLOSED assessed record not already withdrawn.
- **Inputs/outputs:** selected record; optional withdrawal note and confirmation. Output unchanged original record plus at most one withdrawal annotation.
- **Primary workflow:** open any saved record → see phase/commitment/result/gap and accurate qualifiers; for mistaken assessed conclusion choose Withdraw → confirm consequence/no undo → save annotation.
- **Alternative:** UNASSESSED has no assessment to withdraw; can view/delete/new draft. Already withdrawn is read-only with visible original. History opening an unfinished record routes to its current phase, not a stale result screen.
- **Rules/states/validation:** BR007/010/011; no CLOSED→LEARNING, no correction-to-new-verdict, no upgrade assisted/unassessed into independently assessed. Withdrawal stays visible wherever the old result appears. Original/withdrawal times distinct; no progress totals.
- **Errors/recovery/cancel:** wrong/stale record action rejected with current state, no effect on another record. Cancel is no-op. Failure no false withdrawal. Retry yields one annotation. No undo/revision engine; privacy deletion remains available.
- **Dependencies/acceptance:** FR006/009; UX-S01/S05; AC027–030.

## FR-008 — Create a draft from past context

- **Purpose/priority/status:** optional reduction of re-entry for the next bout; SHOULD/PROPOSED, excluded from minimum MUST acceptance unless Founder includes it.
- **Precondition/trigger:** free open slot; user explicitly chooses use past goal/gap as next draft.
- **Inputs/outputs:** selected prior context; output one editable DRAFT. Goal may be prefilled from learner's chosen gap or original goal; no automatic Start.
- **Primary/alternative workflow:** review the proposed goal and source readiness before starting; may edit/save/discard. If slot occupied, offer current record or cancel, never replace it.
- **Rules/states/validation:** BR001/002/003/007/008; no attempt, actual comparison, outcome or withdrawal copied. New session does not resolve old gap or rewrite old result.
- **Errors/recovery/cancel:** no duplicate draft on retry, no original modification, standard save failures. Unavailable optional action does not prevent a complete core session.
- **Dependencies/acceptance:** FR001/002/006/007; UX-J07; AC031–032 only if included. No spaced-repetition scheduler/task manager implied.

## FR-009 — Delete personal learning records

- **Purpose/priority/status:** user controls local retention; MUST/PROPOSED.
- **Precondition/trigger:** record or data-management controls available; delete one, delete all or reset unreadable dataset selected explicitly.
- **Inputs/outputs:** named scope + confirmation; output current dataset without targeted content, or truthful failure. Delete open also clears slot; delete all includes draft/history/withdrawals.
- **Primary workflow:** explain irreversible current-dataset deletion and OS-backup limitation → confirm → whole deletion → success only when absent from app views.
- **Alternatives:** cancel preserves all data; unreadable data uses separate reset flow with total-loss warning, never masquerades as empty first use.
- **Rules/states/validation:** BR008/010/011; no recycle bin/undo or erasure-of-all-backups claim. Repeated confirmation cannot target another record; stale record already deleted yields truthful already-absent state.
- **Errors/recovery/cancel:** failed deletion retains actual last state and retry option; process interruption shows full prior or deleted state, not partly-cleared history/open slot. Do not log learning content to support.
- **Dependencies/acceptance:** FR006/007; UX-J08; AC033–036. No login/password requirement invented for a local accountless app.

# 04 — Journeys and interface responsibilities

Version0.1 · 22/11/2026 · **all UX behavior PROPOSED**. Screen IDs identify responsibilities, not prescribed routes/layout/components. There are no approved Figma/Stitch references, visual mockups or assets. Exact guards and saved-state semantics are in [BR](05-business-rules-and-data.md); this file cannot override them.

## Common interaction contract — UX-001

Display whether edits are unsaved, saving, saved on device or failed. Only explicit save boundaries guarantee recovery. App-controlled navigation with dirty fields offers Save and leave / Keep editing / Discard edits; OS kill may bypass any dialog. Never imply continuous focus from phase. Inline errors name a field, retain text and expose screen-reader feedback; source links are plain references, not auto-opened. Every destructive action has a named-scope confirmation and cancel; state-changing success waits for the whole save. Use neutral learning language, no guilt or achievement grade.

## UX-J01 — A complete self-reported learning bout

- **Entry/objective/initial state:** Home, no open record; learner wants to know whether they can independently do a small task.
- **Actions/steps:** New draft→write observable goal, optional material and comparison plan→Start→study outside app→choose Self-check→declare independent attempt, actual comparison and source→choose self-assessed result/gap→Save conclusion.
- **Validation/state:** FR001/002/004/005 guards; DRAFT→LEARNING→CHECKING→CLOSED. PARTIAL/NOT_YET requires a gap or explicit unknown-gap; no timer threshold.
- **Success:** Summary pairs frozen goal with self-report, reference and gap; no mastery claim. **Failure:** invalid close stays CHECKING with inputs; save failure is not completion.
- **Recovery/exit/return:** retry in place; Save for later keeps phase. History opens exact saved result, does not automatically start the next bout. UX-S01–S05; AC001/005/013/017–020.

## UX-J02 — Missing source, uncertainty or help

- **Entry/objective/state:** Setup or CHECKING, learner cannot currently establish independent performance.
- **Actions/steps:** choose NOT_READY at setup if needed→still Start with limitation visible→at check declare mode and whether comparison actually occurred→save UNASSESSED, optionally retain useful gap.
- **Validation/state:** no assessed result unless BR005 independent+DONE_SUFFICIENT+source guard. If later an adequate source is obtained, actual source can be recorded separately without changing original plan. A comparison done with inadequate basis is retained as such, not a pass. Help during the attempt differs from viewing the answer afterward to compare; an assisted comparison has its own accurate qualifier.
- **Success:** CLOSED with “Chưa có kết luận về tự làm”, or “Chưa xác nhận tự làm — đã đối chiếu có trợ giúp” when applicable; not pass/fail. **Failure:** trying MEETS with assisted/missing comparison is prevented and explained, notes retained.
- **Recovery/exit/return:** no compulsory retry/excuse or rubric search; may return to learning, save partial check, or close unassessed. A closed unassessed record cannot be upgraded by editing later. UX-S02/S04/S05; AC006/014–016/020/021.

## UX-J03 — Leave, interrupt and resume

- **Entry/objective/state:** Any DRAFT/LEARNING/CHECKING; learner needs to leave without claiming success.
- **Actions/steps:** Save draft/Save for later if editing; leave; return from Home to same open record/phase. In LEARNING with no edits, leaving requires no timer/pause operation.
- **Validation/state:** saving partial CHECKING does not require final assessment fields; Back does not conclude or change phase. Lock/background/call/reboot/offline does not automatically pause, fail or complete.
- **Success:** last acknowledged content/phase restored. **Failure:** writing failed gives retry while input remains in process; force-kill may lose only unacknowledged edits on ordinary restart.
- **Recovery/exit:** show actual recovered state; never replay Start/Close blindly or promise all keystrokes. User can continue or deliberately end unassessed. UX-S01–S04; AC008/016/022–024.

## UX-J04 — Return to learning or change the goal

- **Entry/objective/state:** CHECKING when learner wants more study, or started record whose goal must change.
- **Actions/steps:** Return to learning explicitly→warn saved+unsaved check draft will be discarded→confirm or cancel. Alternatively Change goal→warn original closes unassessed and check draft discarded→confirm→new prefilled DRAFT→edit/review→Start separately.
- **Validation/state:** return CHECKING→LEARNING clears check draft, keeps commitment; goal-change closes old UNASSESSED and creates exactly one new DRAFT as a whole. No result/mode/gap transfers; source plan may be prefilled as an editable plan.
- **Success:** correct record and phase displayed; original goal never silently easier. **Failure:** partial new draft/closure not allowed; retry/kill yields intact old or complete new pair.
- **Recovery/exit:** cancel preserves saved and in-memory content. New draft can be edited/saved/deleted; old record stays closed and unassessed. UX-S02/S03/S04/dialogs; AC009/011/012/023.

## UX-J05 — Save failure or unreadable data

- **Entry/objective/state:** any data action, cold start or restore; user wants a truthful recoverable state.
- **Actions/steps:** on failed write see not-saved message→retry, continue editing or explicitly discard; on read failure see data-error view→retry opening or choose separate warned reset if willing to lose dataset.
- **Validation/state:** no “empty history” substitute for corruption; no silent reset, half conclusion or app-controlled exit losing current edits. Success only from actual whole saved state. External kill cannot be blocked.
- **Success:** read succeeds or deliberate reset creates an empty dataset; failed reset stays an error. **Failure:** unavailable storage/read remains visible; no invented backup rescue.
- **Recovery/exit:** preserve recoverable dataset where possible, no automatic overwrites. OS restore may supply older data, including data deleted/withdrawn since its snapshot; never claim latest sync. UX common/error panel; AC022–026/036.

## UX-J06 — Read and withdraw a mistaken assessed conclusion

- **Entry/objective/state:** history/detail of CLOSED MEETS/PARTIAL/NOT_YET not withdrawn; learner realizes the entered verdict was wrong.
- **Actions/steps:** inspect original commitment/result→Withdraw conclusion→read no-undo/current-dataset warning→optional note→confirm→see prominent withdrawn marker and original shown as historical only.
- **Validation/state:** no new assessment, no edits to goal/start/close times. UNASSESSED has no assessment to withdraw; already withdrawn cannot repeat or undo.
- **Success:** all surfaces avoid rendering old verdict as a current valid conclusion. **Failure:** unsaved withdrawal not shown as done; stale selection cannot affect a different record.
- **Recovery/exit:** cancel no-op, retry same annotation once; may delete or start a fresh bout. No fake learning session is created just to mark a mistake. UX-S01/S05; AC027–030.

## UX-J07 — Use a gap next time (SHOULD only)

- **Entry/objective/state:** reading past context, free slot; user wants to revisit a gap.
- **Actions/steps:** explicitly choose source text for new goal→prefilled DRAFT→review/edit comparison plan→Start separately or discard.
- **Validation/state:** no attempt/source-confirmation/verdict copied; no old gap automatically resolved; same BR001 slot guard from every entry point.
- **Success:** one new draft, original unchanged. **Failure/recovery:** occupied slot routes to current record/cancel; failed create retry no duplicates. UX-S01/S02/S05; AC031/032. Core MVP remains complete if this optional action is absent.

## UX-J08 — Delete current data

- **Entry/objective/state:** record detail or data controls; learner wants one record or all learning data removed from current app dataset.
- **Actions/steps:** select named scope→see irreversible/no-undo and historic-OS-backup limit→confirm or cancel→save deletion→refresh views/open slot.
- **Validation/state:** delete one leaves others intact; delete all includes current draft/check/history/withdrawals. Read-error reset is separate and warns data may not be inspectable first.
- **Success:** no targeted data remains in app views; **failure:** no false “deleted”, retry available, no next-record deletion from duplicate taps.
- **Recovery/exit:** interruption yields full prior or deleted state; cancel preserves everything. Future OS restore can reintroduce an older snapshot, as disclosed. UX-S01/S05/dialogs; AC033–036.

## Minimal screen inventory

| Interface | Purpose / displayed information | Available actions and navigation | States/validation/errors | Accessibility and FRs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| UX-S01 — Home/history | One open record with current phase; past records with self-report/unassessed/withdrawn qualifiers; data information | Continue current; New when slot free; view past; delete-all/data info; optional FR008 | Empty is genuine only after successful read; loading/saved-data/read-error distinct; no achievement total | Ordered accessible list, full labels beyond color, no content forced into notifications. FR001/006/007/008/009 |
| UX-S02 — Commitment | Goal example, optional locator, source-ready choice/reference, draft-save status, first-save privacy/backup note | Edit, Save draft, Start, Back, delete draft | Missing/too-long field inline; incomplete drafts allowed; Start validation explicit; open-slot guard | Labels/input purpose, multiline+large text, errors announced, no required personal profile. FR001/002/006 |
| UX-S03 — Open learning | Frozen goal and source plan; workflow-open label, no measured attention/time claim | Self-check, leave, end unassessed, change goal | Saving/error/current-record-changed; no countdown/auto advance | Screen-off allowed, no forced orientation/motion/sound or deadline. FR003/006 |
| UX-S04 — Self-check | Original goal/plan; attempt choices; actual source/comparison status with sufficient/insufficient distinction; verdict/gap/unknown option; partial-save status | Save for later, Save conclusion, end unassessed, return to learning, change goal, Back | No mode/verdict preselection; assessed options conditional; changes clear ineligible verdict, not notes; partial save and final close differ | Form grouping, logical reading order, announced guard/error, assisted label truthful. FR003/004/005/006 |
| UX-S05 — Summary/detail | Original commitment/time context, attempt/comparison facts, result/gap, withdrawal if any | Home; withdraw eligible conclusion; delete; optional new draft | Closed read-only; original vs withdrawn marker unambiguous; stale/deleted record error | Verdict and qualification in one readable group, not icon alone. FR005/007/008/009 |

Confirmation dialogs and the data-error/unsaved-edits panels are shared interaction states, not extra product dashboards/screens. Every dialog identifies record/scope, explains discarded data/no-undo if relevant, and has accessible confirm/cancel without time pressure. No layout, visual style, component framework or native navigation implementation is prescribed.

# 05 — Business rules and product data behavior

Version0.1 · 22/11/2026 · **all BRs PROPOSED**. This defines observable semantics and concepts, not database schemas, APIs, classes or implementation algorithms.

## Concepts and relationships

One local dataset contains learning-session records. A record has an editable draft commitment; once started, its original goal/material/plan become the commitment for that session. An open record can contain a partial self-check draft. A closed record pairs its original commitment with a saved conclusion. A closed conclusion can have one withdrawal annotation. A subsequent session is always a distinct record; copying context never copies an assessment.

The goal describes a small action the learner will try and what they consider sufficient. Material locator is optional text such as a page/exercise reference. Planned comparison source is what they expected to use; actual comparison source is what they declare using. These are text references, not imported content or verified links. Attempt mode and outcome are self-reports. No record represents externally certified knowledge.

## BR-001 — One open record

At most one record in DRAFT, LEARNING or CHECKING exists in the current local dataset. CLOSED records do not occupy the slot. No account/cross-device coordination is promised. Opening setup while a record is open routes to that record, with options to continue or explicitly close/delete it; never silently replace it. Saving a draft is not starting learning. Repeated actions on the same record do not create a second record.

## BR-002 — Input contract

Proposed UX limits, not empirical performance targets: goal1–500 Unicode scalar values; material locator0–300; planned/actual comparison reference0–500; gap/next-step note0–1000; optional conclusion/withdrawal note0–500. Whitespace-only is empty; trim outer whitespace, preserve internal newlines and Unicode content without silent truncation. UI states the limit and identifies the field; test exact boundary and boundary+1 with simple text plus Vietnamese/combining-text preservation. Dev Studio may propose different limits by PCR, not silently truncate.

Drafts may be incomplete but must respect field type/length. Start requires a nonempty goal and an explicit comparison-plan choice: READY requires planned reference text; NOT_READY permits no reference and shows that assessment may be unavailable. Optional material locator does not block Start. Text presence is not proof that the goal is measurable, source adequate or material legally owned. No automatic semantic grading, URL fetching or source validity check.

## BR-003 — Commitment and time

Start freezes the original goal, optional material locator and planned comparison choice/reference. It records the start event; it does not establish sustained attention or time spent learning. Started/closed timestamps are device metadata, not a timer, source of learning truth or guaranteed accurate real time. Clock/timezone changes never change verdicts or auto-close a record. Display relevant time with context; history ordering uses recorded creation order, stable through corrections/clock changes, not a learning ranking.

Editing a learning goal after Start uses the explicit goal-change action: original record closes UNASSESSED with reason “Đổi mục tiêu”; one new DRAFT receives the original setup fields for editing, not attempt/actual-source/outcome/gap. The user reviews and starts the new goal separately. Original closure and new draft are one whole user-visible save, or neither happens. Canceling confirmation changes nothing. No in-session goal version engine.

## BR-004 — Lifecycle and navigation

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> DRAFT: create/save draft
  DRAFT --> LEARNING: Start valid commitment
  LEARNING --> CHECKING: learner chooses self-check
  CHECKING --> LEARNING: return to learning, confirm discard check draft
  LEARNING --> CLOSED: end without assessment
  CHECKING --> CLOSED: save conclusion or end unassessed
  LEARNING --> DRAFT: change goal closes old record + creates new draft
  CHECKING --> DRAFT: change goal closes old record + creates new draft
  CLOSED --> [*]: view/withdraw/delete, no resume
```

The goal-change arrows cross **two records**, not reopening the old record. They implement BR003's whole-action contract. Deleting any record removes it; it is not a learning-success transition. Leaving/locking/killing/rebooting the app does not change phase. No PAUSED/CANCELED state or automatic completion exists in this timer-free baseline. Phase denotes workflow position, not continuous concentration.

| From | Allowed action / target | Guard and data effect |
|---|---|---|
| DRAFT | save/edit DRAFT; Start→LEARNING; delete | BR002 input rules; Start commits snapshot once |
| LEARNING | save/leave LEARNING; enter CHECKING; end→CLOSED; change goal | No minimum duration. End without assessment yields UNASSESSED |
| CHECKING | save/leave CHECKING; conclude→CLOSED; return→LEARNING; change goal | Conclude BR005/006; return requires confirmation and clears check draft only after successful save |
| CLOSED | view; withdraw conclusion; delete; optionally create new DRAFT | Never Resume or edit commitment. Withdrawal is BR007, optional new draft requires free slot |

Screen Back is navigation only. With unsaved edits, offer Save and leave / Keep editing / Discard unsaved edits. Saving partial form does not conclude. Returning to learning from CHECKING is an explicit distinct action, warns about discarding **both saved and unsaved self-check draft content** and preserves original commitment. Goal change gives the same explicit check-draft discard warning. Cancel preserves both saved and in-memory content; success clears the old check draft, not the original commitment. Any unlisted phase transition is rejected without changing the last saved state.

## BR-005 — Eligibility and honest result vocabulary

Attempt mode applies to the particular attempt being reported: INDEPENDENT (“Tôi tự thử, không dùng lời giải/gợi ý để làm lần thử này”), ASSISTED (“Tôi dùng lời giải/gợi ý/trợ giúp trước hoặc trong lần thử để giải câu đó”), NOT_CONFIRMED (“Chưa tự thử hoặc chưa chắc”). Viewing an answer **after committing the attempt, solely to compare it**, is comparison, not assisted solving. No mode preselected. Prior studying is not automatically assistance during this attempt, and a familiar question does not establish transfer to unseen questions. These are declarations, not anti-cheat evidence.

Comparison status is one explicit choice: NOT_CONFIRMED (“Chưa đối chiếu hoặc chưa chắc”), DONE_INSUFFICIENT (“Đã đối chiếu nhưng chưa đủ cơ sở tự kết luận”), DONE_SUFFICIENT (“Đã đối chiếu và có đủ cơ sở tự kết luận theo mục tiêu”). No status preselected. Only INDEPENDENT + DONE_SUFFICIENT + nonempty actual comparison reference enables one of MEETS / PARTIAL / NOT_YET. Mere source text or a completed comparison with inadequate basis never enables an assessed verdict. It is always displayed as **“Tự đánh giá sau đối chiếu: …”**, with attempt mode visible. It never means app-certified mastery. Actual reference may differ from the original plan; retain/display both without editing the original commitment.

ASSISTED, NOT_CONFIRMED, missing/inadequate comparison source, uncertainty or a learner choosing not to conclude can close UNASSESSED. Assistance can still yield a useful gap; it does not yield a verdict about independent performance in this proposed contract. The generic label is “Chưa có kết luận về tự làm”; when ASSISTED and comparison is DONE_INSUFFICIENT or DONE_SUFFICIENT, show “Chưa xác nhận tự làm — đã đối chiếu có trợ giúp”, also retaining whether the comparison basis was insufficient. Never label that case simply “chưa tự kiểm”, which would deny the comparison that occurred. With comparison NOT_CONFIRMED/unset, indicate comparison not established. No forced repeat, excuse or failure label. A source declaration cannot turn uncertainty into a pass. If changed inputs make a selected assessed verdict ineligible, clear that selection, keep notes, explain the guard; do not silently choose another verdict.

## BR-006 — Conclusion validation

MEETS: eligible self-assessment, optional note. PARTIAL/NOT_YET: eligibility plus gap/next-step text **or explicit “Chưa xác định được”**, not a fabricated explanation. The unknown-gap choice and nonempty gap text are mutually exclusive; switching away from entered text requires clear discard confirmation. No app-generated diagnosis or scheduling obligation.

UNASSESSED: no assessed verdict, gap/note optional; retain a supplied attempt mode/actual source as self-report. Closing directly from LEARNING does not invent a mode/comparison. A system reason may describe goal change or missing confirmation, never learning ability. Closed means the record was saved and the slot freed, not that learning was successful. Close requires an explicit user action and a whole saved conclusion.

## BR-007 — Correction without rewriting learning history

Original CLOSED commitment and conclusion are immutable. To correct an entered **assessed** conclusion (MEETS/PARTIAL/NOT_YET, not already withdrawn), user can add a **withdrawal annotation** with optional note; it prominently marks the original as “Kết luận đã được bạn rút lại”. The original remains visible only as original self-report, not as a currently valid assessment in any list, detail or copied context. No new verdict is added, original start/close times are unchanged; withdrawal has its own timestamp. A repeated request yields the same withdrawal, not duplicate annotations. Withdrawal cannot be undone or used to upgrade an unassessed/assisted result; deleting or starting a new session is available. Unassessed records have no assessment to withdraw; mistaken notes can be deleted with the record or contextualized in a new session. This deliberately small correction path is PROPOSED; replacement-result correction remains a documented alternative in the decision register.

Readable history includes assessed, unassessed and withdrawn records with explicit status. A new draft from past content never reuses attempts/verdicts or edits the old record. No achievement score, completion percentage or mastery dashboard derives from records.

## BR-008 — Save, failure, duplicate and interruption semantics

Explicit Save draft, Save for later and state-changing actions are durable save boundaries. “Đã lưu trên thiết bị” appears only when the entire associated state/data is saved. No every-keystroke autosave promise. Unsaved edits may be lost when the process/device dies; acknowledged saves must survive ordinary restart. If failure happens around a save, recovery shows either the full prior state or full new state, never half a conclusion/goal split/deletion. Retrying the same action does not duplicate records, closures or withdrawal.

On write failure, report not saved, keep current input while the process is alive and offer retry or explicit discard; no success message/forced navigation. On restart reconcile from actual durable state rather than replaying a queued UI button blindly. The mechanism belongs to Dev Studio. Concurrent double taps or stale screens cannot overwrite a newer saved/closed/deleted state; show actual current state and permit a fresh deliberate action.

## BR-009 — Self-check drafts and dependencies

Partial CHECKING data is distinct from a CLOSED conclusion. Save for later accepts incomplete final fields while honoring type/length and no invalid final verdict. No saved check draft is shown as a completed assessment. Raw exercise/answer/photo, camera/mic, web imports and answer storage are outside baseline. User compares material outside the app and supplies references, not copyrighted content by requirement. No mandatory app permission or network is needed.

## BR-010 — Retention, backup and recovery limits

Records are retained until user deletion, without silent age expiry or background uploads by Fokus. No account, Fokus cloud sync/backup, analytics upload or recovery service. **PROPOSED policy:** OS backup/transfer may include app data when the OS/user enables it; no guaranteed restore, exact freshness or deletion of historic OS copies. This must be disclosed before the first save and in data information. “Local” does not mean never leaves the device under OS backup.

After an OS restore, operate on the actual recovered dataset: no merging with another device, no guarantee of identifying that a restore occurred, no auto-completion or fabricated missing edits. Old active phase remains an open record. Deleted data **or a previously withdrawn conclusion** can reappear in a pre-deletion/pre-withdrawal OS snapshot; the app cannot promise latest-state recovery or erase every backup. A restored stale snapshot is not falsely presented as synchronized/latest. Uninstall/data-clear/offload/restore behavior must be verified on the eventual support matrix. No backup configuration algorithm or architecture is prescribed.

Unreadable data is an error, not an empty history or permission to overwrite. Offer retry and a clearly separate destructive reset with confirmation only if user chooses to abandon the current dataset; no automatic reset. Preserve recoverable data where feasible, but never claim an invented recovery. Product does not promise salvage after corruption/device loss.

## BR-011 — Deletion and scope

Delete one record requires confirmation naming the record and the current-dataset scope; deleting the open record also clears the open slot. Delete all learning data requires separate explicit confirmation and clears draft/open/history/withdrawal annotations together. Cancel is a no-op. A successful deletion is no longer visible or used by any app view; retry cannot delete another record. Failed deletion reports failure and leaves the actual data state truthful. No recycle bin/undo in MVP; no “erased everywhere” wording. OS copies are outside this command's scope, as BR010 discloses.

# 06 — Non-functional and platform requirements

Version0.1 · 22/11/2026 · **PROPOSED unless marked OPEN**. Normative product expectations are distinct from empirical performance, device verification and legal clearance, all NOT RUN here. No technology stack, schema, architecture, service SLO or deployment prescription.

| ID | Product expectation | Observable verification / limit | Status and trace |
|---|---|---|---|
| NFR-001 — Offline | Cold-open existing data and complete all MUST workflows without Fokus network/account/permissions | Airplane mode before first use and after restart still permits local draft/start/check/close/history/delete. External learning source may be offline/unavailable; use unassessed path, not a Fokus networking error | PROPOSED; FR001–009, AC006/020/022/026 |
| NFR-002 — Data integrity | Acknowledged whole saves survive ordinary restart; one open record, no half conclusion/split/deletion or duplicated retry | Interrupt/inject write failure at save boundaries; inspect user-visible pre/post state and untouched records against BR008, not UI messages alone | PROPOSED; FR006; AC007/012/023/024/033–036 |
| NFR-003 — Honest errors/recovery | No silent data reset, false success or learning inference after interruption | Read failure differs from empty; failed write keeps current input while process lives; explicit warned reset only by user | PROPOSED; BR008/010; AC022–026/036 |
| NFR-004 — Privacy/security | Data minimization; no Fokus account/cloud/analytics/ads/AI upload, no raw learning text in logs/support by default; no sensitive app permission for core | Inspect network/log/support and stored-data behavior on product later. Do not show learning content on lock-screen notifications; none required in MVP. Device security remains boundary, no own vault or “secure against unlocked-device holder” claim | PROPOSED; BR009/010, AC026/037 |
| NFR-005 — Accessibility | Entire MUST loop operable with VoiceOver/TalkBack and large text; outcomes/errors not color-only; no forced sound/motion/timing | Traverse all UX-S surfaces and destructive/unsaved dialogs with screen reader, large text and Vietnamese input; action remains reachable, status/error announced and readable | PROPOSED; UX001; AC038 |
| NFR-006 — Backup and deletion scope | No Fokus backup service; OS backup/transfer may operate under user/OS settings; no latest restore/erase-all-copies promise | Before first save and in data info, disclose scope. Delete current dataset is verifiable; OS copies remain outside command. Restore older coherent snapshot cannot auto-close or claim latest changes | PROPOSED product policy; BR010/011; AC025/033–036 |
| NFR-007 — Platform support | iOS and Android intended; core cannot depend on timer/background/blocker privilege | Device/API/store/support matrix, OS minimums and tablet policy must be proposed by Dev Studio and reviewed before any supported-device claim. No version number guessed from memory | PROPOSED platform direction; **OPEN-003** matrix, AC039 qualification checklist |
| NFR-008 — Performance/capacity | Entry and save flow needs usable feedback without inventing latency/capacity guarantees | Record observed launch/save/list behavior for agreed representative dataset/devices; establish thresholds through Product Clarification before performance sign-off. No assumed “<2s”,99.9%,unlimited history or benchmark PASS | **OPEN-004** numeric targets; qualitative saving/error states PROPOSED via UX001 |
| NFR-009 — Maintainable boundary | No runtime dependence on external content/scoring/account service for core value; data updates must preserve acknowledged records or explicitly fail without destructive overwrite | Future release/update must verify existing records readable and not silently cleared; migration mechanism/rollout belongs to Dev Studio after authorization | PROPOSED; FR006, BR008/010; AC024/026/039 |

No server availability SLA is relevant to the baseline because no Fokus service is required. OS backups and external learning material availability are not a service operated by Fokus. No installation scale, battery number or storage capacity is claimed. Lack of a dataset cap is not a promise of unbounded performance.

## Current feasibility evidence

Prior [platform report](../../sessions/2026-11-21-01-fokus-time/05-platform-feasibility.md) supports a manual local loop as INFERENCE, not tested behavior. Targeted22/11 refresh by Technical reviewer: [Android Auto Backup](https://developer.android.com/identity/data/autobackup) and [Apple iCloud Backup contents](https://support.apple.com/en-us/108770), access22/11/2026; primary documents indicate app data may participate in OS backup. Details/limits in [technical initial](reviews/technical-initial.md). That is documentation evidence, not proof Fokus backup/restore works. No market research rerun.

No timer, notifications, Screen Time/UsageStats/Accessibility blocking, camera/mic or cross-device sync requirement enters this baseline. Such capabilities were conditional/unverified previously; excluding them avoids requiring an unsupported API. Accessibility of the UI is mandatory quality, distinct from using Android AccessibilityService for blocking.

## Product-level risks and future investigation

- **Quality of self-assessment:** rubric/attempt truth unknown; software verifies only declarations and guards. User research/learning outcomes need separate authorized studies; no engine added to solve this.
- **OS backups:** old snapshots can restore deleted/withdrawn content; clear current-dataset deletion copy is essential. Actual platform configuration/disclosures must match tested behavior.
- **Durability:** real storage-full, partial failure, duplicate/stale UI, process death, update and corruption need tests with an independent saved-state oracle; no framework/database mandated.
- **Shared/unlocked devices:** local text may be visible to someone holding an unlocked device; no invented account isolation. Use existing OS protections, verify no content exposure in support/logs; future authentication would require separate product scope.
- **Age/jurisdiction/content rights:** no legal clearance; intended primary user university student, not a separate minors/parental product. Store privacy/content requirements need product-specific review before publication, not an invented gate for writing this specification.
- **Support/performance:** OS versions, devices, dataset profile and limits remain explicit qualification decisions; they do not permit Dev Studio to silently weaken business rules. Device experiment/build is not authorized by this document.

No device, network/privacy, save/recovery, assistive-technology, store, legal or performance test has run on a Fokus application. Passing specification audit later establishes clarity/traceability only.

# 07 — Acceptance criteria and scenario matrix

Version0.1 · 22/11/2026 · **PROPOSED; every application scenario NOT RUN**. This is a product test contract, not a passing test report. All8 MUST FRs have observable scenarios; shared integrity/failure cases apply to each mutation. FR008 is SHOULD and conditional. No learning-efficacy, payment or empirical non-inferiority claim follows from passing these scenarios.

Dev Studio later chooses test implementation after separate authorization. Expected results come from the fixed [BR](05-business-rules-and-data.md) truth table, known before/after record fixtures and visible data after a fresh read/restart, not only the same UI success message or production predicate reused as its own oracle. Failure/crash injections are future test methods, not performed work here.

## Preparation — FR-001

### AC-001 — Save an incomplete draft
**Given** no open record, **when** learner saves a draft with a goal missing or a READY plan lacking source, **then** exactly one DRAFT is saved with values, marked not start-ready; no started/closed result is invented. **Oracle:** fresh reopen shows same draft, not a session outcome. BR001/002; UX-J01/J03.

### AC-002 — Field boundaries and text preservation
**Given** each field's BR002 limit N, **when** saving N scalar values, N+1, whitespace-only and valid Vietnamese/combining text, **then** N is accepted where field otherwise valid, N+1 rejected inline without truncation/input loss, whitespace counts as empty, internal newlines/Unicode content remain readable after save/reopen. Empty goal may save draft but cannot Start. **Oracle:** known input and fresh record comparison. BR002; NFR005; UX-S02/S04.

### AC-003 — Start validation is not semantic grading
**Given** DRAFT, **when** goal is blank, comparison plan unset or READY has blank reference and Start is tapped, **then** stay DRAFT with specific errors and existing input. A syntactically valid goal may Start without the app asserting pedagogical quality/source correctness. BR002; FR002; UX-S02.

### AC-004 — Slot guard at every entry point
**Given** an open DRAFT/LEARNING/CHECKING, **when** New or any past-goal/gap/create-draft entry is chosen, **then** existing record is offered or action canceled; no second open record or silent closure. **Oracle:** complete record set before/after; each entry tested. BR001; FR002/003/008; UX-J07.

## Start — FR-002

### AC-005 — Freeze the exact commitment
**Given** valid DRAFT, **when** Start succeeds, **then** same record enters LEARNING with original goal/material/plan and start event; later check fields do not overwrite them. No timer/permission/network is required. BR003/008; UX-J01; NFR001.

### AC-006 — Source not ready is a legitimate start
**Given** nonempty goal and NOT_READY plan, **when** Start is chosen offline, **then** LEARNING opens with comparison-not-ready notice, without forced source search. Later adequate actual source may be recorded without rewriting original plan; without it only unassessed closure is available. BR002/005; FR004/005; UX-J02.

### AC-007 — Start duplicate and uncertain acknowledgment
**Given** valid DRAFT, **when** Start is double-tapped, retried after a lost acknowledgment or encountered on a stale draft screen, **then** at most one started record/open slot exists. Reopen presents actual prior or complete started state, never a second start event/record. BR001/008; FR006; NFR002.

## Open workflow — FR-003

### AC-008 — Leave without an invented phase change
**Given** LEARNING/CHECKING with acknowledged data, **when** app backgrounds, locks, loses network, is killed or reboots, **then** reopening shows same saved phase/data, with no inferred pause/failure/success and no continuous-focus claim. Screen Back only navigates. BR004/008; FR006; UX-J03.

### AC-009 — Return to learning discards only after consent
**Given** CHECKING with saved and unsaved draft details, **when** Return to learning is selected, **then** warning identifies both sets of check content; Cancel preserves both. Confirmed successful action yields LEARNING with original commitment unchanged and check draft cleared; failure does not clear half the data. BR004/008; UX-J04.

### AC-010 — End without a forced diagnosis
**Given** LEARNING or incomplete CHECKING, **when** learner chooses end without assessment, **then** CLOSED/UNASSESSED is possible without mode/source/reason/gap, never default fail. Retain valid optional details; if unsaved invalid text cannot be stored, offer fix or explicitly discard it and close, not an inescapable validation loop. BR006/008; FR005; UX-J02/J04.

### AC-011 — Goal change does not shrink the past
**Given** started goal “tự giải5câu” and check details, **when** Change goal is confirmed to prepare a smaller goal, **then** old record closes UNASSESSED(reason changed goal), original5-câu commitment remains; one editable DRAFT has setup only, no attempt/comparison/verdict/gap. It is not started automatically. Cancel preserves original phase/data including unsaved check fields. BR003/004; UX-J04.

### AC-012 — Goal-change interruption/duplicate
**Given** goal change is saving, **when** failure/kill/retry occurs across save boundary, **then** observe old open record with no new draft **or** old closed plus exactly one new draft. Never closed-old without draft, two successor drafts or two open records. **Oracle:** independent pre/post fixture plus fresh record set. BR001/008; FR006; NFR002.

## Self-check — FR-004

### AC-013 — Help timing and selection changes
**Given** learner independently attempts and afterward views answer only to compare, **when** declaring mode, **then** this is eligible for INDEPENDENT; help used to solve before/during the attempt is ASSISTED. No mode preselected. Changing an eligible draft to ASSISTED/NOT_CONFIRMED clears an assessed selection visibly but preserves notes. BR005; UX-J01/J02.

### AC-014 — Insufficient comparison cannot pass
**Given** INDEPENDENT and actual source text, **when** comparison is NOT_CONFIRMED, DONE_INSUFFICIENT or unset, **then** MEETS/PARTIAL/NOT_YET cannot be committed. Only DONE_SUFFICIENT plus nonempty actual reference enables self-assessed options; app does not verify the rubric itself. ASSISTED remains unassessed even with sufficient comparison. BR005; FR005; UX-J02.

### AC-015 — Actual source differs from plan
**Given** a frozen planned source or NOT_READY plan, **when** learner later uses another source, **then** save actual reference/status separately and display the distinction; original goal/plan unchanged. Empty actual reference prevents assessed conclusion even when status says sufficient. BR003/005; UX-S04/S05.

### AC-016 — Partial check save and return
**Given** CHECKING with incomplete mode/status/outcome/gap, **when** Save for later is used, **then** basic valid partial fields save and phase stays CHECKING; final Close validation is not applied. Restart recovers the partial draft and never presents it as a closed assessment. BR008/009; FR006; UX-J03/J05.

## Conclusion — FR-005

### AC-017 — Eligible self-assessed result
**Given** INDEPENDENT + DONE_SUFFICIENT + actual source, **when** MEETS is explicitly chosen and saved, **then** CLOSED stores full conclusion once; summary states “Tự đánh giá sau đối chiếu” with mode/source and original goal, no mastery/score claim. Optional gap/note may be empty. BR005/006; UX-J01.

### AC-018 — Gap required without forcing invention
**Given** eligible PARTIAL or NOT_YET, **when** gap text is empty and unknown-gap not chosen, **then** close stays CHECKING with error/input preserved. Nonempty valid gap **or** explicit unknown-gap allows close; selecting both is not allowed, switching from entered text warns before discard. No compulsory next-study date or generated diagnosis. BR006; UX-S04.

### AC-019 — Close once and free the slot
**Given** valid conclusion, **when** Save conclusion succeeds/repeats, **then** one CLOSED record keeps goal/result/gap together, slot becomes free once, no automatic successor session. Duration/opening check never performs Close. BR001/006/008; FR006; UX-S05.

### AC-020 — Assisted and uncertain conclusions stay truthful
**Given** ASSISTED with DONE_SUFFICIENT or DONE_INSUFFICIENT, **when** closing UNASSESSED, **then** useful optional gap remains and summary says comparison occurred with help, retaining insufficient-basis qualifier when relevant. With not-confirmed comparison, do not claim comparison occurred. Independent but uncertain may also close UNASSESSED without excuse, retry or pass/fail. BR005/006; UX-J02.

### AC-021 — Reject stale/forbidden conclusion mutations
**Given** record already CLOSED/deleted or input gates became ineligible, **when** a stale screen tries assessed Close or Resume, **then** no rewrite/new result happens; actual current state is shown. Invalid phase/action does not change commitment. BR004/005/008; UX-S04/S05.

## Persistence — FR-006

### AC-022 — Acknowledged versus unsaved edits
**Given** an acknowledged draft/check save followed by new unsaved text, **when** ordinary process death occurs, **then** acknowledged data survives; edits since that boundary may be absent and are not falsely said saved. App-controlled leaving offers save/discard/keep-editing; external kill is not promised preventable. BR008; NFR002/003; UX-J03/J05.

### AC-023 — Whole action under failure
**Given** known records before Start, Close, return-and-clear, goal split, withdrawal, delete-one or delete-all, **when** save failure/kill is injected before/during/after each commit boundary, **then** fresh read yields coherent full pre-action or full post-action state; no half result/split/deletion, accidental record loss or duplicate retry. Success feedback is not the only oracle. BR008; every mutating FR; NFR002.

### AC-024 — Failed writes, stale UI and future update
**Given** a readable dataset and current inputs, **when** write fails or another saved action invalidates a stale UI action, **then** no false success/app-controlled loss; current input remains while process lives and retry is deliberate. A future app update must preserve readable acknowledged records or report a data error without clearing them. BR008/010; NFR002/003/009.

### AC-025 — Older OS snapshot is not latest sync
**Given** an OS snapshot predates later deletes/withdrawals/edits, **when** OS restores it, **then** app shows coherent recovered data as local data, no claim latest changes restored and no automatic old-session completion. It need not detect restore or erase external copies; data information warns old content may reappear. BR010; NFR006; UX-J05.

### AC-026 — Offline read failure and no silent reset
**Given** cold start offline, **when** data reads successfully, **then** all core local actions work without account/sensitive permissions. **When** reading is corrupted/unavailable, **then** show data error and retry, not empty history or automatic reset. Do not overwrite recoverable dataset to bypass error. BR009/010; NFR001/003; UX-J05.

## History and withdrawal — FR-007

### AC-027 — History is context, not a learning score
**Given** assessed, unassessed, open and withdrawn records, **when** listing/opening them, **then** each shows true phase/result qualifiers and original commitment; no mastery total/streak or implication all closed sessions met goals. Stable recorded creation order does not reshuffle from clock change or withdrawal; open record routes to current phase. BR003/007; UX-S01/S05.

### AC-028 — Withdraw a mistaken assessed conclusion
**Given** CLOSED assessed record not withdrawn, **when** user confirms withdrawal with optional note, **then** original goal/result/start/close retained, one withdrawal timestamp/annotation added, every surface marks original no longer current. No new verdict, reopened session or fake study bout. BR007; UX-J06.

### AC-029 — Withdrawal eligibility and no upgrade
**Given** open, UNASSESSED, assisted/unassessed or already withdrawn record, **when** withdrawal/new-verdict editing is attempted, **then** action is unavailable/rejected without changing record or another assessment. No undo or unassessed→assessed correction path. Valid privacy deletion remains available. BR007/011; UX-J06.

### AC-030 — Withdrawal cancel/failure/retry
**Given** eligible original, **when** Cancel or save failure occurs, **then** no false withdrawn marker and prior current state remains truthful. A committed action whose acknowledgment was lost appears once after reopen/retry, not duplicate annotations. BR007/008; FR006; UX-J06.

## Optional next draft — FR-008 (if approved/included)

### AC-031 — New context, never copied success
**Given** closed context and free slot, **when** user chooses use old goal/gap, **then** one editable DRAFT receives only chosen setup text, no mode/actual comparison/outcome/gap-success state; user reviews source readiness and Starts separately. Original unchanged. BR001/003/007; UX-J07.

### AC-032 — Optional action obeys the slot
**Given** an occupied slot or failed create, **when** past-gap action is tapped/retried, **then** do not replace/close existing work or create duplicate drafts; offer current work/cancel. Absence of this optional feature does not fail MUST baseline. BR001/008; UX-J07.

## Deletion — FR-009

### AC-033 — Delete exactly one
**Given** multiple records including an open one, **when** a named record deletion is confirmed and succeeds, **then** only that record/annotations disappear from current app views; others unchanged; deleting open frees slot. Copy warns irreversible current-dataset scope and historic OS copies not erased. BR010/011; UX-J08.

### AC-034 — Delete all learning data
**Given** draft/open/history/withdrawals, **when** separate Delete all confirmation succeeds, **then** all learning data in current dataset is absent, no hidden open slot or derived result remains. App does not promise OS copies erased or disable future restore. BR008/010/011; UX-J08.

### AC-035 — Destructive cancel, failure and duplicate
**Given** selected delete scope, **when** Cancel/write failure/double-confirm occurs, **then** cancel has no effects, failed save has no false success, successful retry deletes only intended scope once and never the next record after navigation. Fresh read follows whole-action rule. BR008/011; FR006; UX-J08.

### AC-036 — Explicit reset after unreadable data
**Given** read-error state, **when** learner chooses reset, **then** separate confirmation warns all current data may be lost and cannot be recovered by Fokus. Cancel preserves dataset/error; successful reset creates a genuinely empty readable dataset; failed reset stays error, not fake first use. BR010/011; FR006; UX-J05/J08.

## Cross-cutting qualification

### AC-037 — Privacy boundary
**Given** text-only baseline with no account/telemetry, **when** completing core flows and exercising errors, **then** no Fokus content upload/AI/ads/analytics, no raw learning text in support/logs by default, no sensitive permission prompt required, no content notification. First-save/data information accurately distinguishes device saves and OS backup. **Oracle:** future network/log/storage inspection plus visible copy, not a privacy slogan. NFR004/006; FR001–009.

### AC-038 — Accessible complete workflow
**Given** supported iOS/Android devices with VoiceOver/TalkBack and largest supported text setting, **when** traversing all MUST screens, error and confirm dialogs, **then** every action/field/status/error is reachable and meaningfully read, no essential control clipped, no color/sound/motion/time-limit dependence, Vietnamese entry preserved. NFR005; UX001, UX-S01–S05.

### AC-039 — Platform/performance sign-off remains separate
**Given** no approved support matrix/numeric performance profile yet, **when** preparing future implementation/release qualification, **then** mark those checks OPEN/NOT RUN, obtain proposed OS/device/dataset thresholds through OPEN003/004 and PCR before claiming support/performance PASS. Business behavior cannot be silently changed to pass. This is a handoff qualification rule, not an executed product benchmark. NFR007/008/009.

## Traceability and execution status

Registry02 maps allFRs to these IDs; BR/UX/NFR references above are dependencies, not circular test evidence. Reuse failure scenario AC023 for every data mutation, including the optional FR008 if included. Independent expected state must also confirm unrelated records unchanged.

**Current status:** all application scenarios NOT RUN; no application exists in this scope. Specification review can establish completeness/consistency and traceability, never implementation correctness or user outcome. No generated software tests, test framework or infrastructure is part of this package.

# 08 — Proposed MVP boundary

Version0.1 · 22/11/2026 · **PROPOSED; not Founder-approved scope or build authorization**.

One primary segment: university student independently studying a small exercise/topic with their own legitimate material and a comparison method. One problem: ending a bout without a clear conclusion about what they could do and what remains uncertain. One workflow: commitment→learning→self-attempt/comparison→qualified conclusion→readable gap. One proposed benefit: a useful self-reported conclusion that can guide the next bout with acceptable effort. No learning/business evidence is fabricated.

| Priority | Scope | Why essential / dependency |
|---|---|---|
| MUST | FR001 draft/commitment and FR002 explicit Start | A result needs a prior goal; freeze avoids rewriting goal to claim success |
| MUST | FR003 manual workflow controls, source-not-ready/unassessed exit and goal-change split | Real sessions are interrupted and goals change; no forced pass/fail or trapped form |
| MUST | FR004/005 self-check and qualified conclusion | This is the product's core loop, including sufficient basis, assistance and uncertainty rather than timer-based completion |
| MUST | FR006 acknowledged save, whole actions and recovery | A lost/half goal-result or duplicate restart invalidates the record's meaning |
| MUST | FR007 readable history and withdrawal correction | A gap must be findable, and a mistakenly entered assessed conclusion must stop appearing current without inventing a new bout |
| MUST | FR009 scoped deletion/reset | Local personal learning content needs truthful user-controlled retention and failure behavior |
| MUST quality | NFR001–006 and NFR009; UX common behaviors | Offline, privacy, accessibility, durability, honest backup/retention and update behavior are quality requirements, not optional polish |
| SHOULD | FR008 use past goal/gap as a reviewed new draft | Can reduce re-entry; not necessary for the user to manually begin a fresh bout. Only include after explicit scope approval; AC031/032 then apply |
| COULD | No additional feature proposed | No quota to fill and no unspecified feature implied |
| OUT OF SCOPE | Timer/Pomodoro/countdown/alarms; app blocking/usage capture; focus-minute/attention claims; accounts/Fokus backup/sync; AI/content generation/grading; question bank/spaced repetition; photos/voice/upload; social/leaderboard/pets/streaks; parent/teacher portal; payments/ads/analytics SDK; full task/course manager | These add dependencies or a different product without establishing the selected loop's incremental value. They are council-proposed exclusions, not invented Founder REJECT decisions |

Past research considered a timer as an optional aid in conversation; it was never approved. Current proposal explicitly excludes it. No feature that disappeared in peer review is silently reintroduced through NFR, screen inventory or handoff.

## Functional dependency and review order

First establish the meaning of commitment/result, single slot and whole saved actions (BR001–009/FR006). Then demonstrate the whole FR001→002→003→004→005 workflow including unassessed exit. Complete readable history/withdrawal/deletion and all recovery/accessibility/privacy cases; these are still MUST, not postponed safeguards. Only then consider the separately approved SHOULD convenience. This is a dependency explanation and high-level functional order, not engineering sprints or a delivery commitment.

Complexity **INFERENCE, relative**: small local text scope is lower than blocker/social/tutoring systems; two OS, state integrity, backup boundaries and assistive technology still require competent engineering/verification. Team capability/cost/calendar estimate UNKNOWN. Do not interpret “small” as production ready or permission to skip tests.

## Proposed acceptance boundary

Every MUST FR must meet its AC plus shared crash/failure/duplicate/privacy/accessibility scenarios. NFR007/008 support/performance qualification must be resolved before claims or future sign-off; thresholds are not guessed here. Learning efficacy, app increment over worksheet/Anki/RemNote and commercial viability require separate evidence, not an added grading system or automated analytics in this MVP.

Founder approval of a scope later would still not initiate Dev Studio. Separate explicit implementation authorization and bounded scope are required.
